name: OpenBB-finance/OpenBB
what_it_holds: Large open-source 'investment research platform' (73k+ stars, 6800+ commits) aggregating many data providers behind one Python/CLI interface, including forex/FX modules pulling from multiple upstream providers (some free, many require third-party API keys). No committed dataset -- it is integration plumbing.
why_useful: Could be used as a single client to assemble ad hoc FX, macro and equity data pulls (including peer 8-K-style data and options) without hand-rolling each API wrapper, but most useful feeds need a paid key so value is mainly as a convenience layer, not a new data source.
last_activity: very active (6863 commits on develop, current)
duplicate_of_holding: Overlaps broadly with things we already source directly (FRED, options chains); flagged low because of key requirements
themes: FX and purchasing power: exchange-rate history (ECB, BIS, FRED), broad-dollar indices, PPP/Big Mac, tourist affordability indices, company FX-exposure tooling
why_all: Could be used as a single client to assemble ad hoc FX, macro and equity data pulls (including peer 8-K-style data and options) without hand-rolling each API wrapper, but most useful feeds need a paid key so value is mainly as a convenience layer, not a new data source.

name: RomelTorres/alpha_vantage
what_it_holds: Python wrapper for the Alpha Vantage API's FX endpoints (get_currency_exchange_rate and related forex time-series calls), returning pandas DataFrames. Requires a free Alpha Vantage API key (not a paid key, generous free tier).
why_useful: Cheap way to pull historical daily FX time series for currency pairs relevant to ABNB's regional mix (EUR, GBP, MXN, BRL, AUD, JPY vs USD) if FRED coverage of a specific cross is thin; also has stock/equity time series in the same client.
last_activity: not shown but actively maintained, widely used package
time_coverage: Whatever Alpha Vantage's free tier exposes (typically full daily history for majors)
size_hint: small python library, no data committed
duplicate_of_holding: Overlaps with our existing FX schedules; only useful if a specific cross is missing
themes: FX and purchasing power: exchange-rate history (ECB, BIS, FRED), broad-dollar indices, PPP/Big Mac, tourist affordability indices, company FX-exposure tooling
why_all: Cheap way to pull historical daily FX time series for currency pairs relevant to ABNB's regional mix (EUR, GBP, MXN, BRL, AUD, JPY vs USD) if FRED coverage of a specific cross is thin; also has stock/equity time series in the same client.

name: owid/owid-datasets (Our World in Data, archived)
what_it_holds: Archived (as of 14 Apr 2025) OWID collection of CSV+datapackage social/economic indicator datasets by country; likely includes historical PPP and exchange-rate-adjusted GDP series (could not confirm exact folder contents from the fetched page -- OWID's live Grapher/ETL and Chart API at ourworldindata.org now supersede this repo for current data). Worth a follow-up directory listing if pursued.
why_useful: If it still contains PPP/exchange-rate-adjusted series in committed CSV form, it would be a long-run, easy-to-diff complement to the Big Mac index and World Bank PPP factors for tourist affordability comparisons.
license: unspecified in fetched content (OWID data typically CC BY)
time_coverage: unclear from fetch, likely multi-decade per OWID convention
themes: FX and purchasing power: exchange-rate history (ECB, BIS, FRED), broad-dollar indices, PPP/Big Mac, tourist affordability indices, company FX-exposure tooling
why_all: If it still contains PPP/exchange-rate-adjusted series in committed CSV form, it would be a long-run, easy-to-diff complement to the Big Mac index and World Bank PPP factors for tourist affordability comparisons.

name: banxico-api
what_it_holds: Python package to fetch Banxico economic/financial series with metadata handling and date-range queries. 1 star, MIT, updated Dec 2024.
why_useful: Alternate, actively-typed Banxico client if sie_banxico is unmaintained; same use case (Mexico FX/macro pull).
themes: Regional macro for LatAm and APAC: Mexico INEGI/Banxico, Brazil IBGE/BCB, Argentina INDEC, Colombia DANE, Chile, Japan e-Stat, Korea KOSIS, Australia ABS, India MOSPI clients
why_all: Alternate, actively-typed Banxico client if sie_banxico is unmaintained; same use case (Mexico FX/macro pull).

name: sie_banxico_bi
what_it_holds: Python library to retrieve and visualize Mexican economic indicators via the Banxico SIE API, wrapping https://www.banxico.org.mx/SieAPIRest/service/v1/doc/consultaSeries. 1 star, updated Jul 2026.
why_useful: Another actively-touched Banxico wrapper with visualization built in; marginal over sie_banxico but confirms the SIE API pattern is well-trodden and easy to build on.
themes: Regional macro for LatAm and APAC: Mexico INEGI/Banxico, Brazil IBGE/BCB, Argentina INDEC, Colombia DANE, Chile, Japan e-Stat, Korea KOSIS, Australia ABS, India MOSPI clients
